[#hash-backends-of-ripemd]
.Who implements `ripemd_128`, `ripemd_160`, `digests::ripemd_160` (RIPEMD-128 and RIPEMD-160 (Dobbertin, Bosselaers, Preneel))
[cols="2,1,2,2,3,1",options="header"]

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_MD-*.pod, doc/man3/EVP_DigestInit.pod and providers/implementations/digests/ state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::ripemd_160`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
